name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use?

env.description: ADSP environment / access service to target: test = access-uat.alberta.ca (UAT — use for dev and pre-prod), prod = access.alberta.ca, dev = ADSP platform dev (restricted). Defaults to test.

tenant.description: ADSP tenant name. Looks up the tenant realm and opens a single browser login, avoiding a separate interactive tenant selection.

tenantRealm.description: Keycloak realm UUID. Optional when --tenant is provided — overrides the realm looked up from the tenant service.

accessToken.description: Access token for retrieving configuration from ADSP APIs.

serviceClientId.description: Client ID of a paired backend service (e.g. urn:ads:my-tenant:my-svc). When provided with --tenant, configures audience mapping and example-role scope on the frontend client.

pairedProject.description: Name of an existing backend service project (e.g. an express-service) to derive the nginx/dev-server proxy config from automatically, plus the adsp:proxy-service: tag the sandbox executor reads to pre-create its Service. The project must already exist. --proxy is still available for additional entries this doesn't cover, but can't duplicate the location this derives.

skipAgent.description: Skip the consultAgent interaction and generate base scaffolding only.
